snippet.title: HEXA'S GONE - Official Trailer | Multiplayer Deduction Game [4K]
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4371070/Hexas_Gone/

The secret Hexa has vanished. Are you ready to find it?

Hexa's Gone is a competitive multiplayer deduction game where logic is your only weapon.
Spot player clues and uncover the truth.
Will you be the one to solve the mystery, or will you be the next one to vanish?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Music: Policy - 5x One Star
